title: Hardcoded IV or nonce (universal) — review required
description: An initialization vector or nonce is assigned a fixed literal: (?:iv|IV|nonce)s*[=:]s*["'][A-Za-z0-9+/=]{8,}["']. Reused IVs make equal plaintexts encrypt equally and can destroy the security of stream-like modes. This lexical rule flags the literal; the reviewer confirms uniqueness or generates it randomly.
remediation: Generate a fresh random IV per message (a CSPRNG draw) and store it alongside the ciphertext.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches literal IVs regardless of cipher mode.
